best_narrative.body: Hims operates a multi-category consumer telehealth platform with material dependency on compounded GLP-1 sourcing and asynchronous prescribing workflows across state jurisdictions. FDA enforcement actions on GLP-1 compounds spiked to 11 in the week of November 9, 2026, signaling accelerated federal scrutiny that typically precedes state-level pharmacy board coordination in top-exposure states including California. California's pharmacy board enforcement posture on compounded weight-loss compounds directly constrains Hims' supply chain and prescriber compliance obligations.
